brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Clear typographic hierarchy with bold titles, accent-colored stats, and consistent body text creates legible scanning across floating cards
Colored left borders per card act as a meaningful taxonomy cue, tying tags and threads into a coherent visual language
Dark canvas with restrained neon accents gives the 3D knowledge space a confident, focused mood
dominant_weaknesses: Cards overlap heavily and clip each other's text ('Design System Evolution', 'Customer Journey Mapping'), breaking legibility and undermining the depth metaphor
'Threads' connecting notes are barely visible thin lines — the core brief's connection concept is undersold and feels accidental
Depth cues are inconsistent: opacity differs but scale, blur, and parallax don't reinforce 'recent near, old far,' so the 3D promise reads as flat layered rectangles
fix_priorities: Resolve card occlusion with smarter layout, hover-to-front, or true z-depth scaling so titles never clip
Make connection threads first-class: thicker, animated, color-matched to relationship type
Strengthen depth language with blur, scale, and motion parallax tied to recency
Tighten the right-side stats panel — the 47/12/3D/Live grid competes visually with the canvas
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral mood is solid and reflective intrigue is real, but behavioral usability suffers from overlap and weak interaction affordances.
rationale.intent_fit: It gestures at the 3D-notes-with-threads concept but reads as overlapping 2D cards rather than a navigable spatial knowledge graph.
